body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure MISHRI has auto release set up with full construct uploads to artifacts in a separate job check parena for the idea of what is a construct in terms of github workflows'. Added a new release job to .github/workflows/ci.yml matching PARENA's own exact release-job structure (fetch-depth:0 for tag history, compute-next-minor-version script, gh release create, regular/non-prerelease per this monorepo's own standing 'auto release non pre release' convention), gated to push-to-main, needs:[test, construct_bundle]. MISHRI has no compiled binary, so the full real construct bundle (txt/tar.gz/zip, already produced by the separate construct_bundle job) IS the release asset -- a real, versioned, downloadable source snapshot per release. Top-level permissions bumped to contents:write with every other job explicitly scoped back to contents:read. MISHRI commit 75b3d6b.

⚓ ☃
title: Auto-release CI job added, full construct bundle as release asset
